description: Defines the AudioRendererPassthrough class for UWP platform, handling audio rendering, media timing, and interaction with WASAPI audio sink.

classes.name: AudioRendererPassthrough
classes.description: A class for UWP platform that manages audio rendering with passthrough, media timing, and interaction with WASAPI sink.

methods.name: AudioRendererPassthrough
methods.description: Constructor initializing the audio renderer with a decoder and stream info.
